title: Muse will look for Poppy first. You still set the permissions.
friendlyTitle: Muse looks for a shop's agent file first. You still set the limits.
summary: Sierra has released version 1.0 of the Personal Agent Protocol, or Poppy, so a personal agent can connect to a company's agent, website, or API. Sierra says every Shopify store now publishes a Poppy file automatically, and Meta's Muse looks for Poppy first on every site it visits. Access uses OAuth, and the customer can change what the agent is allowed to do.
friendlySummary: Sierra has released version 1.0 of Poppy, a way for your personal agent to talk to a company's agent, website, or software. Sierra says every Shopify store now publishes the file automatically, and Meta's Muse looks for it first on every site. You sign in and choose what the agent may do, and you can change that later.
whyItMatters: The protocol is a door, not a purchase. If a shop has not implemented Poppy, the agent is back to the ordinary page. A permission you granted is still yours to revoke, and a booking or payment made in your name is still yours if it is wrong.
friendlyWhyItMatters: This opens a door. It does not buy anything by itself. If a shop has not set it up, the agent is back to the normal page. A permission you gave is still yours to take back, and a booking made in your name is still yours if it is wrong.
